title: Nexus CoreError
description: Wire error envelope for nexus-core / native / service adapters (NexusApiError-compatible categories).

code.description: NexusApiError-compatible category. not_supported refuses an operation this service does not serve (unsupported operations fail with this code and zero side effects; the finer lowercase peer wire code, e.g. op_unsupported, is preserved in details.wire_code).
